items.title: Path of Exile 2 ExileCon Qualifier #3 Is Going On Now!
items.excerpt: The ExileCon Path of Exile 2 Qualifier #3 is happening now! Who will join Jiluo and Giuygiuyg in the finale at ExileCon this November? Watch the action live at https://www.twitch.tv/pathofexile! Co-streaming is welcome. Twitch Drops are now available for 24 hours, until 2 PM PDT on August 21. Watch the official broadcast or any channel streaming Path of Exile 2 for 30 minutes during the race, or catch up with your favourite content creator afterwards, to receive the Coliseum Helmet Attachment. For more details about the event, check out the announcement here. Good luck to all participants!

items.title: The Last of the Druids Microtransactions Are Now Available in Store
items.excerpt: Microtransactions from the Last of the Druids Mystery Box have finally been released in the store for Path of Exile 1 and Path of Exile 2! From Armour Sets to Portals and Level-Up Effects, there are over 60 new microtransactions available, giving you even more ways to customise your Exile and show off your style. Check out the full selection in the store, or watch the video below to take a closer look at everything included in the Last of the Druids Mystery Box. Thank you for your support!

items.title: Play Path of Exile 2 at gamescom 2026
items.excerpt: In just two weeks, Path of Exile 2 will be heading to gamescom in Cologne, Germany. If you’re attending, make sure to pop by our booth to play the special demo available exclusively at the event. gamescom ONL kicks off on August 25th at 11am PST. Tune into the Twitch livestream here to make sure you don’t miss our reveal! If you’re attending in person, you can find our booth at Hall 6.1 | B031. We still have a number of demo slots available on the weekend so if you’re a content creator or a member of media looking to cover the event, feel free to reach out to us at media@grindinggear.com. items.title: Path of Exile 2 at gamescom 2026
items.excerpt: Path of Exile 2 will once again be heading to gamescom in Cologne, Germany. Play a special demo available exclusively at the event, snap some photos with our eerie display, and pick up exclusive merchandise. We'll be sharing more details closer to the event, and we hope to see you there! If you're a content creator or member of the media looking to cover the event, feel free to reach out to us at media@grindinggear.com.
